... on 12 September, 2024
 The Honourable Sri Justice K.Sarath
 Writ Petition No.26077 Of 2018
Order:

This Writ Petition is filed under Article 226 of Constitution of India for following relief:
"...to issue a Writ, Order or Direction more particularly onein the nature of Writ of Mandamus to declare the impugned action of 4th respondent at the instance of 5th respondent in interfering with the construction work made by the petitioner in the land an extent of 281.42 Sq. Yards in Survey No.35/AA situated at Sivar for Raikal Village under the limits of Raikal Grama Panchayat without following due procedure as illegal, and irregular..."

2. Heard learned counsel appearing for the petitioner and learned Assistant Government Pleader for Panchayat Raj and Rural Development and learned Standing Counsel for Gram Panchayat appearing for the respondents, and perused the entire material on record.
3.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that admittedly this Court has granted interim order on 26.07.2018, directed the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner.

4. In spite of lapse of more than six (06) years, the respondents neither filed counter-affidavit nor vacate ::2::
petition denying the averments made by the petitioner in the writ affidavit.
In view of the same, requested this Court to allow the writ petition.

5. In view of the submissions made by the learned counsel for the petitioner and on perusing the entire material on record, this Court feels it appropriate to dispose of the writ petition, directing the respondents not to interfere with the possession of the petitioner's property without following due process of law.

If the respondents want to acquire the land of the petitioner, they have to follow the procedure as contemplated under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013

sentences.text: 6. With the above direction, this Writ Petition is disposed of.
There shall be no order as to costs.
7. Miscellaneous Applications, if any pending in this writ petition, shall stand closed.
